Accommodations include rooms, cottages and villas, as well as rustic thatched roof tree houses and private caves. All come with TVs, living rooms and kettles; some have minifridges. Cottages have balconies, and villas add verandas with private pools and hot tubs. Amenities include a casual restaurant and a coffee shop. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, tennis, a kids’ park and an Ayurvedic spa. Activities consist of guided plantation walks and cardamom factory tours. Breakfast is available.

Featuring terraces with lake, garden or pool views, the relaxed cottages with classic, Kerala-style architecture offer complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and tea and coffeemaking facilities, as well as living rooms; some are bi-level. Distinctive touches include sloped ceilings and 4-poster beds. Kids age 4 and under stay free with their parents. Breakfast and parking are complimentary. There's also an airy restaurant, an outdoor pool, a game room and an Ayurvedic spa, plus yoga lessons. Boat tours are available.

name: Tranquil Resort
title: Resort hotel
description: Laid-back rooms & treehouses on a tranquil coffee/spice plantation offering free breakfast & dinner. On a 162-hectare coffee and spice estate, this serene resort is 5 km from the Wayanad Heritage Museum and 7 km from Edakkal Caves. Down-to-earth rooms are situated in an annexe with a patio and a garden; all offer flat-screens, safes, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. A room in the main house has beamed ceilings and wood floors, while a suite offers a living room and private garden. Rustic treehouses are accessed by walkways in the forest canopy, and feature balconies with plantation views. Free perks include parking, and breakfast and dinner served in an open-air dining room. There's also an outdoor pool. Ayurvedic massages are available.

Accommodations range from rustic bamboo cottages to polished villas and treehouses. All include en suite bathrooms and free Wi-Fi. Breakfast is included and is served in a casual, multi-cuisine restaurant. The hotel has an outdoor pool, and a spa offering Ayurvedic treatments. Other amenities include a playground, a game room and a lake with boating.

description: Straightforward rooms, plus a modern restaurant, a bar, a coffee shop & meeting space. Set 5 km from the Feroke Railway Station, this unassuming business hotel is also 11 km from Kadalundi Bird Sanctuary and 13 km from Shahre Mubarak Grand Masjid mosque. The understated rooms and suites feature Wi-Fi, safes, minibars and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms add air-conditioning, and suites feature living areas. Complimentary amenities include a breakfast buffet and parking. There's a modern restaurant and bar with a chandelier, plus a coffee shop and meeting and event space. A doctor is on call.

description: Laid-back treehouses & villas in a tranquil rainforest resort with a restaurant & a spa. Surrounded by rainforest, this informal, tranquil resort is 4 km from Pookode Lake and 27 km from Thusharagiri Falls. Reached by rope walkways in the trees, the simple TV-free treehouses offer kettles, mosquito nets and balconies. Airy villas come with living areas, private pools and/or whirlpool tubs. Kids age 4 and under stay at no charge in a parent’s room. Room service is available. Free perks include parking, and breakfast and dinner buffets served in a casual restaurant. There's also a cafe, a gym, and a spa offering Ayurvedic therapies, plus an outdoor pool, a TV room and a game room.

name: Meiveda Ayurvedic Beach Resort

description: Airy villas with terraces in a serene beachfront resort offering yoga & Ayurvedic treatments. Surrounded by coconut groves, this tranquil resort is on Mannalamkunnu Beach facing the Arabian Sea. It's 11 km from an elephant sanctuary at Guruvayoor elephant camp and 68 km from Calicut International Airport. The 7 simply furnished villas offer flat-screen TVs; some feature canopy beds, dinette tables, and terraces with garden views. Air-conditioning (fee) is available. Breakfast is offered. There's a garden and a shaded outdoor area for yoga and meditation classes. A range of Ayurvedic treatments are available, as is vegetarian cuisine catered for special diets.

description: Unfussy rooms & cottages in a hotel featuring an open-air restaurant with a terrace & lake views. Surrounded by lush hills on the banks of Hiranya Lake, this relaxed hotel on 6 hectares of grounds is 6 km from Daulatabad train station and 10 km from the stunning rock-cut temple complex Ellora Caves. Featuring hill views, the unfussy rooms provide Wi-Fi access and flat-screen TVs, as well as tea and coffeemaking facilities. Cottages with tentlike roofs add porches. Room service is available. Breakfast is complimentary. Amenities include an open-air restaurant with a terrace and lake views, and a garden featuring an outdoor pool. There's also a campsite. Tours and candlelit dinners, along with activities such as rock climbing, are offered.

description: Understated quarters in a modest countryside resort with a relaxed eatery, a garden & loaner bikes. Set 1 km from the monumental Ellora monastery-temple cave complex, this modest resort is 29 km from Aurangabad Train Station and 5 km from the scenic Bani Begum Mogul Garden. Simply furnished dorms offer bunk beds, ceiling fans and shared bathrooms. Private rooms have flat-screens and en suite facilities. Cottages add air-conditioning and terraces; upgraded cottages feature fridges. Room service is available. Parking and breakfast are free, as are loaner bikes and yoga mats. description: Polished rooms & suites in an upmarket hotel offering dining & a bar, plus a spa & an outdoor pool. Set on 2 hectares of lush gardens, this upscale hotel in a palatial building is 5 km from Bibi Ka Maqbara, a famed 17th-century marble tomb, and 10 km from Aurangabad Airport. Polished rooms and suites come with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, plus minibars, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. All offer balconies or terraces with pool and/or garden views. Upgraded suites provide separate living rooms. There's a refined restaurant and a garden cafe, along with a teahouse and a hip bar.
